title: Manager, Software Engineering
description:
Do you want to advance your career with the world’s first cloud company? Since 1998, Oracle NetSuite has been on a mission to deliver an agile, unified application suite that gives leaders a complete view into their business. Our team is growing, and we’re looking for people like you to help us make a global impact.

As the leading cloud business system, NetSuite includes financials, inventory management, HR, professional services automation, commerce, and more. Tens of thousands of customers all over the world trust NetSuite to give their businesses the visibility, agility, and control needed to make data-informed decisions quickly. NetSuite is a place where you can build your career and have fun while doing so! We’re invested in our people, our customers, and the community. As part of Oracle, our benefits are second to none. Joining our passionate team means that you’re ready to take your career to the next level. With priceless learning opportunities, strong support, incredible innovation, and volunteer opportunities, NetSuite is committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels empowered and set up for success.

**Our company culture:**

* We help each other and foster collaboration across roles and teams.
* We lift each other up. We know how to celebrate our successes and learn from our failures.
* Ideas are fragile and we consider them no matter how simple or outlandish.
* We always try to do the right thing – for ourselves, for the product and ultimately for our customers.

**How will you crush it?**  
  
You'll work with awesome people that care about their craft and what they deliver. Your efforts will contribute to making things better for thousands of our customers.

You will collaborate strongly with our partners in Product Management, Security and Compliance – we’re all pulling in the same direction to deliver the secure, reliable software our customers want and need.

  

**You will fit perfectly if you share these values**

* People first.
* Manage a team of 7+ Engineers.
* Being open-minded for discussions and promoting team collaboration.
* Taking initiative, responsibility, and ownership of the projects.
* Driving continuous improvement of the team's productivity, product, and processes.
* Provide career growth and development opportunities for the team and build effective backup/succession plan to handle unanticipated attrition.
* Interact with product management and other engineering teams ( XD, Devops, Tech support, Release teams etc.) to develop / release software products which fulfill the requirements defined by the product owner.
* Provide technical leadership to the team for design, architecture, code reviews and incorporate engineering best practices into feature development, refactoring work and product maintenance.
* Determine the staffing required for scrum teams to complete assigned tasks. Facilitate the required trainings for the team to help them to complete their tasks.
* Experience working with Quality Leads.
* Responsible for hiring of software engineers for agile development teams.
* Mentor, train and motivate software engineers to increase overall technical skillsets and stay current with technology trends.
* Drive the annual performance reviews and appraisal process for the team.
* Participate in the campus / Industry hiring drives.
* Work with team to resolve customer issues as per defined service level agreements.
* Able to successfully deliver committed features on time and meeting project objectives/deadlines.
Participate in various scrum ceremonies such as Daily scrum calls , Sprint Planning, Sprint Retrospection  

**Qualifications/Skills**

* Bachelor/Master degree in computer engineering or equivalent.
* 12+ years of software development experience in a technical capacity and minimum 3 years of managerial experience.
* Expertise in any of the development technologies : Java or C#.
* Expertise in designing complex solutions, code reviews, providing architectural input on team-wide/cross-location projects, defining branching strategies and able to drive cross-team initiatives.
* Good familiarity with testing pyramid, test plans, automation, code coverage, continuous integration, performance and security testing.
* Monitoring the team productivity and maximizing utilization across various projects / initiatives.
* Keep up-to-date with technology trends & processes while driving adoption of the same , encourage innovation and lead knowledge sharing strategies. Should be able to pick up and deliver stories/tasks based on the project needs.
* Expertise in agile methodology and handling of scrum teams.
* Assist the team to unblock issues by providing effective resolutions.
* Delegate to engineers with clearly defined responsibility and empowerment.
* Expertise in dealing with performance management which includes regular 1-1's, performance /appraisal discussions with the engineer.
* Ensuring team is adhering to the organizational policies and guidelines.
* Proven ability to drive and enhance team engagement, fostering a collaborative and motivated work environment.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
* Experienced in managing high performance teams , understanding their feedback and guide them in their career path.
* Ability to attract/recruit/retain talent
* Be a coach, mentor and employee champion.
* Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to abstract functional requirements.

title: Senior Analyst - IT Infrastructure
description:
Overview:

The Senior Analyst IT Infrastructure will be responsible for assisting with day-to-day IT support for local end-users while coordinating seamlessly with our global IT framework. Managing a highly technical environment of approximately 150 developers, 300 endpoints (mixed Mac and Windows), and corporate conference rooms, this role focuses on maintaining strict SLAs, elevating the customer service experience, and driving hands-on deskside support.

This is a 100% on-site, highly hands-on role designed for a professional capable of understanding complex infrastructure, working with global teams, managing asset lifecycles under local regulatory frameworks, and acting as the operational anchor for the site.

Responsibilities:

* SLA & Ticket Management: Responsible for supporting all incidents and service requests within defined Service Level Agreements (SLAs), while assisting the Manager with escalations.
* Service Management Platforms: Fully understand, leverage, and demonstrate strong working knowledge of ServiceNow and Jira Service Management to track, manage, and optimize ticketing, customer-friendly support methods, and developer workflows.
* Asset & CMDB Governance: Own the local IT lifecycle from procurement to disposal. Ensure absolute integrity of the Configuration Management Database (CMDB) by meticulously tracking, auditing, and updating configurations and status changes for all local hardware and software assets.
* SEZ Regulatory Compliance: Direct and manage the movement of IT assets in strict accordance with Special Economic Zone (SEZ) regulations and STPI guidelines. Handle the end-to-end documentation for procurement, local clearances, and the formal bonding and de-bonding of infrastructure assets.
* Endpoint & Identity Governance: Execute operating system deployments, manage device compliance initiatives, and oversee identity/access management processes to ensure all local endpoints strictly align with global IT and security standards.
* Global Collaboration & Infrastructure: Partner seamlessly with IT infrastructure teams across the globe; maintain a deep understanding of corporate infrastructure architecture to ensure local systems align perfectly with global standards.
* Cross-Functional Engagement: Proactively interface with regional and global functional heads to understand local business needs, deliver technical solutions, maintain mutual expectation levels for service delivery, and manage customer satisfaction.
* Deskside & Platform Support: Provide consistent, expert-level delivery of team support services for software, hardware, and performance-related issues across a mixed environment of Microsoft Windows and Mac OSX personal computers, peripherals, and mobile devices (iOS/Android).
* AV & Collaboration Spaces: Take full hands-on ownership of corporate conference rooms, including the support of Video/Audio conferencing technologies and the physical/software integration of Shure products.  
  Root Cause Analysis: Evaluate complex engineering issues and identify root-cause problems/solutions to prevent future service delivery quality issues.
* Global Project Support: Support the successful execution (on-time and within budget) of IT Infrastructure projects in the region, assisting with project planning and execution across varying Projects.
* Procedures & Documentation: Follow and execute internal procedures, ticketing, and escalation standards. Identify, recommend, and implement programs to advance user adoption, training, and knowledge management.

Qualifications:

* Education: Bachelor’s degree or similar level education in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Experience: Minimum of 6 to 8 years of experience working in a technical infrastructure discipline (i.e. desktop support).
* Compliance & Systems Management: Direct, hands-on experience handling IT infrastructure tracking within an SEZ/STPI environment. Demonstrated experience managing device compliance, endpoint security policies, and modern identity/access management workflows (Okta or similar).
* Deployment Architecture: Proven experience handling enterprise operating system deployments (OSD) and automated provisioning tools for mixed environments (Windows & Mac).
* Engineering Alignment: Demonstrated experience providing IT service delivery and customer support in a technical, engineering, or software development center capacity.
* Technical Environment Mastery: Broad knowledge of personal computers and peripherals, latest Microsoft Windows and Mac OSX operating systems, Microsoft Office suites including Office 365, corporate Microsoft Active Directory, and Exchange environments.
* Network & Infrastructure: Solid foundational knowledge of enterprise voice and data networking (LAN/WAN) services.  
  Core Soft Skills: Good English communication skills (written and verbal), a highly structured work style, and the ability to exercise judgment within defined practices to prioritize workload independently.
* Process Framework: Demonstrated knowledge and practical experience with the ITIL framework required.

**WHO WE ARE**

Shure’s mission is to be the most trusted audio brand worldwide – and for over a century, our Core Values have aligned us to be just that. Founded in 1925, we are a leading global manufacturer of audio equipment known for quality, reliability, and durability. We engineer microphones, headphones, wireless audio systems, conferencing systems, and more. And quality doesn’t stop at our products. Our talented teams strive for perfection and innovate every chance they get. We offer an Associate-first culture, flexible work arrangements, and opportunity for all.

Shure is headquartered in United States. We have more than 35 regional sales offices, engineering hubs, distribution centers and manufacturing facilities throughout the Americas, EMEA, and Asia.

Join Shure and **Amplify Your Impact.** Explore our unique culture and learn the key pillars that define our legacy of excellence.

**THE MIX MATTERS**

Don’t check off every box in the job requirements? No problem! We recognize that every professional journey is unique and are committed to providing an equitable candidate experience for all prospective Shure Associates. If you’re excited about this role, believe you’ve got the skills to be successful, and share our passion for creating an inclusive, diverse, equitable, and accessible work environment, then apply!

title: Eng I, Eng Run
description:
**About Invesco**
=================

As one of the world’s leading independent global investment firms, Invesco is dedicated to rethinking possibilities for our clients. By delivering the combined power of our distinctive investment management capabilities, we provide a wide range of investment strategies and vehicles to our clients around the world. If you're looking for challenging work, intelligent colleagues, and exposure across a global footprint, come explore your potential at Invesco.

**What's in it for you?**
=========================

As an organization we support personal needs, diverse backgrounds and provide internal networks, as well as opportunities to get involved in the community and in the world.

Our benefit policy includes but not limited to:

* Competitive Compensation
* Flexible, Hybrid Work
* 30 days’ Annual Leave + Public Holidays
* Life Insurance
* Retirement Planning
* Group Personal Accident Insurance
* Medical Insurance for Employee and Family
* Annual Health Check-up
* 26 weeks Maternity Leave
* Paternal Leave
* Adoption Leave
* Near site Childcare Facility
* Employee Assistance Program
* Study Support
* Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* ESG Commitments and Goals
* Business Resource Groups
* Career Development Programs
* Mentoring Programs
* Invesco Cares

**Job Description**
===================

**Key Responsibilities**

**Application & Production Support**

* Provide day-to-day support for business applications and resolve client-reported issues in a timely and professional manner.
* Investigate, diagnose, and resolve application, data, and system-related incidents.
* Monitor application health, system performance, and batch processing activities to ensure service availability and reliability.
* Perform regular system checks and proactively identify potential issues before they impact users.
* Coordinate with development, infrastructure, and business teams to resolve complex production issues.

**Data Management & Monitoring**

* Intermediate SQL skills with an understanding of relational databases, data models, and database concepts.
* Basic to intermediate programming or scripting knowledge (Python preferred).
* Basic understanding of ETL and ELT processes, job scheduling tools (e.g., AutoSys, UAC), and data pipeline operations, with the ability to support troubleshooting and issue resolution under the guidance of senior engineers.

* Exposure to cloud technologies such as Snowflake, AWS Services, or Informatica Cloud is a plus.

**System Enhancements & Upgrades**

* Assist in application releases, upgrades, and system enhancements.
* Participate in testing activities, validate functionality changes, and support user acceptance testing.
* Support implementation of small enhancements and automation opportunities to improve operational efficiency.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and process optimization efforts.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* Internship, academic project, or prior experience in data engineering, ETL development, application support, or software development is preferred.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to learn new technologies and adapt to changing business requirements.
* Ability to manage assigned tasks effectively and deliver quality work within established timelines.
* Demonstrates attention to detail, accountability, and a commitment to operational excellence.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with team members, business partners, and support teams in a fast-paced environment.

**Documentation & Process Improvement**

* Maintain accurate and up-to-date support documentation, run books, and operational procedures.
* Identify opportunities to improve team processes, monitoring capabilities, and support standards.

**Collaboration & Customer Service**

* Communicate effectively with business users, vendors, and technical teams regarding incidents and service requests.
* Provide exceptional customer support while managing multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Participate in on-call, after-hours, weekend, and holiday support as required.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working within **Agile/Scrum** development environments.
* Exposure to the **Financial Services** industry is highly desirable.
* Experience with automation, process improvement, and operational excellence initiatives.

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science**, Information Systems, Management Information Systems, Business Administration**, or a related discipline.
* Equivalent relevant work experience may be considered in lieu of formal education.

**Working Conditions**

* Hybrid work model with **4 days per week in the office**.
* Flexibility to support business-critical applications outside normal business hours when required.
* Participation in evening, weekend, holiday, and on-call support rotations.
* Dynamic and fast-paced environment requires collaboration across global teams.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

A successful candidate will combine strong technical troubleshooting skills with excellent customer service, demonstrate ownership of production environments, proactively improve operational processes, and contribute to maintaining a stable and reliable application support landscape.

**Grow Your Career with Us**

Build the skills and experiences that help you thrive in a constantly evolving business environment. title: Portfolio Lead
description:
**Company Description**

There's nothing like a career at Entain India. We're the technology powerhouse helping Entain – a world leader in sports and gaming – create products and experiences used by millions of customers across the globe. Whether you're an engineer, product owner or customer care professional, unlock a world of new possibilities – for you and the future of sports and gaming.

 **Job Description**

The Portfolio Lead is accountable for delivery performance across a sub-domain of 4-6 pods (Engineering, Quality, Product). They lead the flow of value from idea to production, ensuring pods deliver with pace, predictability and understanding to outcomes.

They combine hands-on delivery leadership with AI-augmented ways of working and data-driven decision-making. They do not prescribe a single framework - instead they adapt approaches that best serve each pod's context.

They partner with Engineering and Product leadership to reduce waste, improve throughput and help pods achieve Autonomy, Accountability and Agreement to value outcomes.

**What you will do**

**Pod Performance & Accountability**

You are responsible for pod delivery performance across the sub-domain.

You will lead and communicate delivery health, risks and performance to leadership

Ensure pods operate as, self-organising units delivering value outcomes

Support pod leads with coaching, facilitation and conflict resolution

Ensure cross-pod agreement on priorities, dependencies and shared goals

Facilitate communication and collaboration between pods to promote knowledge sharing

**Problem Solving**

You will be an expert; deploy root cause analysis, systems thinking and structured techniques to analyse and guide out resolutions.

Be an escalation point for cross-pod blockers and systemic impediments

Identify patterns across pods that indicate deeper organisational or process issues

**AI-Augmented Delivery**

Champion AI agent adoption across pods - including coding agents, test generation, story creation, board health and deployment automation

Identify opportunities where AI can reduce toil, accelerate delivery or improve decision-making

Apply AI to improve delivery effectiveness, including workflow insights, risk prediction, and automation of reporting

Track and demonstrate the impact of AI on delivery performance

**Flow & Efficiency**

Monitor and improve delivery flow (lead time, cycle time, WIP, throughput) using Kanban and lean principles

Ensure WIP limits are respected and surface ageing items through Board Walks

Identify bottlenecks, ageing work and sources of delay across pods.

Improve through regular assessment and experimentation.

Support teams in breaking down work into deliverable, value-driven increments

**Agile Ways of Working**

Support and evolve the agile operating model for a pod-based environment focused on pace, not ceremony.

Adapt delivery approaches (Kanban, flow-based, lean) appropriate to each pod's needs

Ensure consistency of practice across pods without being prescriptive

Promote outcome-driven delivery vs output-driven activity

Guide teams to operate with autonomy and accountability

**Metrics & Reporting**

Define and maintain delivery metrics: cycle time, flow efficiency, lead time of initiative, PDLC compression, dependency reduction, rework rate, team satisfaction, and AI effectiveness

Build dashboards (cumulative flow diagrams, throughput charts, WIP ageing) that provide leadership visibility and lead informed decision-making

Analyse performance data to identify trends, patterns and areas for improvement

Use data to facilitate conversations and coach pods — not just track output

**Stakeholder Management**

Partner with Engineering and Product leadership at sub-domain level

Represent delivery health and risks in leadership forums

Build trusted relationships that allow fast decision-making

Communicate delivery performance to both technical and non-technical audiences

**Commercial Awareness**

Understand the commercial context of the sub-domain

Connect delivery decisions to revenue, cost, and customer impact

Support prioritisation trade-offs with a business lens

**Capacity Planning**

Forecast capacity across pods based on team composition, skills mix and upcoming demand

Identify resourcing gaps and support hiring/allocation decisions

Balance workload across pods to prevent burnout and underutilisation

Support realistic planning by ensuring pods have clear understanding of available capacity

**Risk & Dependency Management**

Manage risks through regular assessment and execution of controls

Ensure cross-pod dependencies are visible, tracked and managed

Track dependency cost (time blocked, items affected) and lead mitigations such as contract-first development and feature flags

Support issue escalations, ensuring intervention by the dependency escalation protocol

**Coach & Capability Development**

Provide hands-on coaching at pod level

Build capability in workflow management, flow thinking, estimation, planning, and data-led decision-making

Support teams in understanding and improving their own performance

Strengthen a culture of continuous improvement and learning

**Outcome & Value Focus**

Align delivery to always ensure outcomes and value.

Help teams understand the why behind their work and how their outputs contribute to value

Challenge work that does not link to outcomes

Support measurement of delivery against OKRs and value indicators

**Centre of Excellence (CoE) Contribution**

Be an active contributor to the CoE

Share best practices, delivery insights and improvement opportunities from pods

Support adoption of standards, playbooks and tools

Help evolve delivery practices based on experience

 **Qualifications**

**Specialist Experience**

You will have 7+ years in delivery/agile roles, with at least 3 years operating across multiple teams simultaneously in a technology environment

Expert in flow-based delivery approaches (Kanban, lean, continuous delivery) — not limited to Scrum

Experience enabling multiple teams/pods simultaneously at scale

Strong understanding of AI tooling and its application to software delivery (coding assistants, automation, intelligent analytics)

Experienced in capacity planning, demand forecasting and resource optimisation across multiple teams

Use data to solve complex problems; can interpret and communicate complex data sets clearly

Previous experience of organisational transformation and change management

Good knowledge of Objectives and Key Results (OKR) strategy

Experience in a regulated industry (gaming, fintech, or similar) desirable

**Competencies & Behaviours**

You will embody the Maker Dimensions - selecting for capability, not just competence. We are looking for people who are versatile, curious, and able to operate with autonomy in a high-trust environment.

**AI Fluency** uses AI tooling; experiments; iterate with AI as a collaborator

**Agency & Accountability** Owns outcomes, not just tasks; directs itself.

**Systems Thinking** Sees patterns across pods and addresses causes, not symptoms

**Stakeholder Engagement** Builds working relationships across pods and leadership

**Improve Performance** Raises the bar through data and experimentation

**Cross-functional Versatility** Comfortable operating beyond their primary discipline

**Product Sense** Connects their work to customer and outcomes

**Build Capability** Invests in developing pods, individuals and self

 **Additional Information**

**Benefits**

At Entain India, we offer a package and the support people need to make an impact. Join us, and a great compensation package is just the beginning. You can expect to receive benefits like:

* Safe home pickup and home drop.
* A regular bonus and great pension.
* 24 days annual leave.
* Extra paid leave, including wellbeing and development days.
* Life assurance and Income Protection.
* Private healthcare and wellbeing support.
* INR 3,000 per month Communication allowance.
* Up to INR 16,000 per year in Crèche expenses (children under 3).

**Equal Opportunities**.

If you need any **reasonable adjustments** at any stage of the recruitment process, please contact us and we'll support you.

We're committed to creating a diverse, equitable and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, respected and able to be themselves.

We're an **equal opportunities employer**. We welcome applications from everyone and we do not discriminate based on age, disability, gender or gender reassignment, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sexual orientation, marriage/civil partnership, or any other basis.

We comply with all applicable recruitment regulations and employment laws in the jurisdictions where we operate, ensuring ethical and compliant hiring practices globally.

title: Senior Azure Data Engineer
description:
**Job Description:**

**Position Summary**

We are seeking a Senior Azure Data Engineer with 8+ years of experience designing, developing, and optimizing large-scale data platforms. The ideal candidate brings strong expertise in Microsoft Azure data services, Microsoft Fabric, and Data Lake architecture, along with hands-on experience in financial forecasting modeling, PySpark, and SQL programming.

In this role, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams to build robust, scalable, and secure data pipelines and analytics platforms that support business intelligence, financial planning and analysis, data science, and advanced analytics initiatives.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Data Integration and Pipeline Development**

* Design, develop, and maintain data ingestion, transformation, and integration pipelines using Azure Data Factory, Microsoft Fabric, and Azure Synapse Analytics.
* Integrate data from disparate systems and applications, ensuring data is reliable, well-documented, and fit for downstream analytics.
* Develop and maintain scalable data-processing solutions using Python and PySpark.
* Write, review, and optimize SQL programs for data transformation, analysis, and reporting, including complex queries and database objects as appropriate.
* Optimize data flows and pipeline performance for scalability, efficiency, and reliability.

**Cloud Architecture and Implementation**

* Architect and implement Azure Data Lake and Delta Lake solutions for structured and unstructured data.
* Build and support data solutions using Microsoft Fabric and its applicable data engineering and analytics capabilities.
* Utilize cloud-based data warehouse and data lake solutions.
* Apply modern data architecture patterns, including Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold) design.

**Financial and Business Analytics**

* Partner with finance and business stakeholders to understand financial planning, forecasting, and analytical requirements and translate them into data solutions.
* Work with financial models and the data that supports them, helping ensure inputs, transformations, assumptions, and outputs are traceable and reliable.
* Prepare, integrate, validate, and structure financial and operational data for modeling, analysis, and business intelligence.
* Collaborate with analysts to improve the quality, consistency, and usability of data used in financial and performance reporting.

**Collaboration and Leadership**

* Provide technical guidance and promote engineering best practices for Azure- and Fabric-based data solutions.
* Communicate technical concepts, design decisions, and data limitations clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

**Performance Monitoring and Optimization**

* Monitor data quality and performance metrics; investigate and resolve data-related issues.
* Continuously optimize pipelines, SQL queries, and database structures for efficiency and reliability.
* Apply appropriate data quality checks and operational controls to support trusted analytics.

**Required Skills and Experience**

**Technical Skills**

* Strong understanding of data modeling, including dimensional modeling, star schemas, and snowflake schemas.
* Hands-on experience with Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2, Azure Data Factory, Azure SQL Database, and Azure Synapse Analytics or SQL Data Warehouse.
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric for data engineering, data integration, or analytics workloads.
* Strong experience programming in SQL, including writing and tuning complex queries and working with relational database objects.
* Proficiency in Python and PySpark for data processing and transformation.
* Demonstrated experience working with financial models or financial modeling processes, and preparing or validating financial data for forecasting, planning, or analytical use.
* Familiarity with Power BI or other data visualization tools.
* Knowledge of modern data architectures, including Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold) design patterns.

**Professional Skills**

* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across technical and business teams.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to manage priorities and deliver in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
* Strong documentation and reporting skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 8+ years of experience in data engineering, with a focus on cloud-based architecture.
* Proven expertise in the Azure data ecosystem and experience delivering production data solutions.
* Demonstrated hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric, PySpark, and SQL programming.
* Experience working with financial models or financial modeling data and requirements.
* Bachelor’s degree in mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Engineering, or a related business or analytical discipline.
* Domain experience in supply chain management, logistics, or finance analytics, supporting data-driven decision-making across the enterprise.

title: Senior Lead Systems Operations Engineer
description:
Senior lead systems operations

**In this role, you will:**

* Act as an advisor to senior leadership to develop or influence platform support solutions for highly complex business and technical needs or technology initiatives
* Lead highly complex, broad impact initiatives including provision of high-level systems consultation for the technology teams related to large scale planning of computer systems and network infrastructure for Systems Operations functional areas
* Lead the strategy and resolution of highly complex and unique challenges requiring in-depth evaluation across multiple areas or the enterprise, delivering solutions that are long-term, large-scale and require vision, creativity, innovation, advanced analytical and inductive thinking
* Translate advanced technology experience, in-depth knowledge of the organizations tactical and strategic business objectives, the enterprise technological environment, the organization structure, and strategic technological opportunities and requirements into technical engineering solutions
* Provide vision, direction and expertise to senior leadership on implementing innovative and significant business solutions
* Maintain knowledge of industry best practices and new technologies and recommend innovations that enhance operations or provide a competitive advantage to the organization
* Strategically engage with all levels of professionals and managers across the enterprise and serve as an expert advisor to leadership
* Provide training and mentoring to less experienced team members on guidebook changes and lead team to meet technical deliverables, while leveraging solid understanding of technical process controls or standards

**Required Qualifications:**

* 7+ years of Systems Engineering, Technology Architecture experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education

**Roles & Responsibilities:**

* Monitor any issues reported via TMIM Joint Technology Command Center (phone lines and chats via MIM Central/Teams). Engage support teams for Major Incident via everbridge paging
* Monitor the TMIM Command Center screens and tools (Down detector, Grafana, Service Now etc.), escalate as necessary in timely manner. Facilitating bridge lines to assist in the resolution of issues including but not limited to software, connectivity, vendor and hardware technology issues that affect various business channels and customers
* Provide leadership coverage being an SME possessing Technical expertise driving the Major Incident bridge to ensure holistic support, proactive monitoring and overall health of Banking Infrastructure and application-based Services including IT applications, tools, infrastructure (hardware, data and software), security information access, system performance and data integrity
* Utilizes appropriate IT tools to resolve issues with global, complex technical, business and mission critical environments
* Recognizes recurring problems and proactively work with cross-functional teams to recommend solutions and process improvements
* Collaborate with other Infrastructure, application teams and business units to lead, monitor and resolve system outages ensuring availability management of Network, Storage, OS, DB, Cyber Security, Mainframes, job schedules, Banking applications etc…
* Business Process Knowledge such as Digital Banking, Community Banking, Wholesale Banking, Wealth Advisors, Trading or Consumer Lending
* Working Knowledge of Netcool, Big Panda, SNOW, MS teams, Cloud services & Splunk
* Lead the technical bridge to reduce MTTR, enable team members to oversee processes to ensure timely completion, quality and compliance in Technology Major Incident Management (TMIM) competency
* Flexible to work 24\*7 and on-call basis based on business demands, working in a fast paced, high-energy environment that requires constant attention and decision making when major incidents occur collaborating with  
  global teams
* Identify opportunities for process improvement in Major incidents and proactive problem management.
* Manage the costs, demand, and resource capacity for the team resources, leveraging external resources as needed.
* Make decisions collaborating with the TMIM team and resolve issues related to technology operations and application deliverables.
* Being part of an on call for escalation, for engagement on P1/P2/P3 major incidents impacting business
* Collaborate with global team and consult with peers, colleagues and managers.
* Actively monitor several critical technology monitoring screens at the Command Center locations
* Proactively handle any incoming issues reported and drive seamlessly within agreed SLA's.
* Demonstrated experience in facilitating virtual, enterprise-level meetings for production events.
* Proficient level experience with incident management, problem management, and change management.
* Demonstrated ability to assess and support complex technical issues and initiatives related to large-scale systems.
* General knowledge of application and infrastructure domains, including Web, Application, Database, and Server technologies. Mentor and guide talent development.
* Lead complex, broad impact initiatives including provision of high-level systems consultation for the technology teams.
* Work as key participant in large scale planning of computer systems and network infrastructure for Systems and Operations functional area.
* Make decisions on technical changes and enhancements.
* Collaborate and consult with technical peers, colleagues, and mid to more experienced level managers to resolve systems support issues and achieve goals.

**Desired Qualifications:**

* 7 + years’ experience of technology experience
* 7+ years’ experience of technology delivery and relationship management experience with small and large business units in a large corporate environment
* 5+ years’ experience of complex issue resolution experience

Trust & Safety team members are tasked with identifying and taking on the biggest problems that challenge the safety and integrity of our products. title: Infrastructure Engineer III- Network
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

You belong to the top echelon of talent in your field. At one of the world's most iconic financial institutions, where infrastructure is of paramount importance, you can play a pivotal role.
  
  
As an Infrastructure Engineer III at JPMorgan Chase within the Infrastructure Platforms team, you utilize strong knowledge of software, applications, and technical processes within the infrastructure engineering discipline. Apply your technical knowledge and problem-solving methodologies across multiple applications of moderate scope.
  
  
**Job responsibilities**

* Applies technical knowledge and problem-solving methodologies to projects of moderate scope, with a focus on improving data and systems running at scale, and ensures end to end monitoring of applications
* Implement and operate data center network services including builds, migrations, upgrades, expansions, and decommissions in alignment with enterprise standards
* Translate business and technical requirements into implementation plans that meet performance, resiliency, security, and operational goals
* Create and maintain network documentation, including implementation plans, as-built diagrams, standards, and operational runbooks
* Partner with application teams, infrastructure stakeholders, and vendors to plan and deliver network changes safely
* Coordinate and execute cutovers to ensure low-risk changes and successful implementation outcomes
* Troubleshoot complex network issues across routing, switching, and network services
* Drive root-cause analysis and remediation to reduce recurring incidents and improve stability
* Improve processes and contribute to automation and standardization efforts to drive operational excellence
* Uses enterprise-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to accelerate monitoring and capacity analysis and documentation, validating outputs and handling operational data according to sensitivity and security requirements.
* Applies reuse-first, AI-assisted approaches to identify recurring capacity risks and improve remediation workflows, ensuring changes are validated and aligned to resiliency and security expectations.

**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Formal training or certification on infrastructure engineering concepts and 3+ years applied experience
* Demonstrates strong hands-on experience of network engineering and/or implementation experience in a large-scale enterprise environment
* Demonstrates strong hands-on experience with routing technologies and protocols (BGP, OSPF, IS-IS)
* Demonstrates strong hands-on experience of implementing or operating Cisco networking solutions (e.g., Nexus, Catalyst) or equivalent experience with comparable platforms (e.g., Arista, Juniper)
* Strong understanding of IP routing fundamentals
* Strong understanding of Ethernet switching fundamentals
* Strong understanding of network security concepts (segmentation, ACLs, firewall integration)
* Working knowledge of enterprise network services and connectivity patterns (e.g., DNS, web proxy patterns, VPN technologies, multicast where applicable)
* Strong knowledge of one or more infrastructure disciplines such as: hardware, networking terminology, databases, storage engineering, deployment practices, integration, automation, scaling, resilience, and performance assessments
* Demonstrated experience using enterprise-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to support infrastructure engineering workflows with strong validation habits and awareness of data sensitivity.
* Ability to review and validate AI-assisted recommendations before implementation, escalating when uncertain and ensuring outcomes align to resiliency, security, and auditability expectations

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Bring low-latency data center networking experience (e.g., Nexus 3K / Arista-class platforms, or similar ultra-low-latency environments)
* Hold relevant networking certifications (e.g., Cisco certifications)
* Leverage scripting/automation skills (e.g., Python, Bash/KSH, or similar) to support repeatable implementations and operational efficiency
* Demonstrate experience with load balancing and firewall technologies (e.g., F5, Check Point, Fortinet or equivalent) and working in multi-platform, distributed enterprise environments with strong change management rigor

title: AI Foundry BU Deployed Engineer
description:
FactSet creates flexible, open data and software solutions for over 200,000 investment professionals worldwide, providing instant access to financial data and analytics that investors use to make crucial decisions.

**AI Foundry - BU Deployed Engineer**

**Role Overview**

The AI Foundry Forward Deployed SBU Engineer serves as the bridge between AI platform capabilities and real-world financial workflows. This role combines deep domain expertise in capital markets with strong AI engineering skills to rapidly design, prototype, deploy, and scale AI-native solutions for specific business units and strategic client opportunities.

Unlike a traditional software engineer, this individual is expected to operate at the intersection of product, engineering, consulting, and financial workflows. They must understand how investment professionals, advisors, bankers, analysts, portfolio managers, and relationship managers work, and be capable of helping existing teams translate their applications from legacy systems to modern AI-native designs. The ideal candidate is comfortable with tackling large open-ended problems, designing agent workflows with product teams, integrating APIs and MCPs with engineers, and demonstrating solutions directly to clients.

Develop reusable patterns that can transition from custom solutions into scalable platform capabilities.

1+ Years experience building AI-based applications.

* Prompt engineering
* Agent architectures
* Vector search / RAG
* Evaluation frameworks
* Workflow orchestration
* Cloud-native development

Preferred:

* Multi-agent systems
* Knowledge graphs
* Retrieval systems
* Fine-tuning concepts
* Agent memory systems
* AI governance frameworks

**Engineering Fundamentals**

10+ Years experience building software applications.

Required:

* Solution architecture
* Security and governance
* Software development lifecycle
* Production deployment experience
* CI/CD
* Containerization

**Product Builder Mindset**

Enjoys creating ambiguous zero-to-one solutions.

  

**What's In It For You**

* At FactSet, our people are our greatest asset, and our culture is our biggest competitive advantage. Being a FactSetter means:
  + The opportunity to join an S&P 500 company with over 45 years of sustainable growth powered by the entrepreneurial spirit of a start-up.

FactSet ( NYSE:FDS | NASDAQ:FDS ) helps the financial community to see more, think bigger, and work better. title: IT&D Senior Cyber Analyst-Security Monitoring & Threat Response
description:
**We are Reckitt**
------------------

Home to the world's best loved and trusted hygiene, health, and nutrition brands. Our purpose defines why we exist: to protect, heal and nurture in the relentless pursuit of a cleaner, healthier world. We are a global team united by this purpose.Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege.

**Information Technology & Digital**
------------------------------------

In IT and D, you'll be a force for good, whether you're championing cyber security, defining how we harness the power of technology to improve our business, or working with data to guide the innovation of consumer loved products.  
  
Working globally across functions, you'll own your projects and process from start to finish, with the influence and visibility to achieve what needs to be done. And if you're willing to bring your ideas to the table, you'll get the support and investment to make them happen.  
  
Your potential will never be wasted. You'll get the space and support to take your development to the next level. Every day, there will be opportunities to learn from peers and leaders through working on exciting, varied projects with real impact. And because our work spans so many different businesses, from Research and Product Development to Sales, you'll keep learning exciting new approaches.

**About the role**
------------------

Are you passionate about leveraging technology to drive business excellence? We are seeking a highly skilled IT&D Senior Cyber Analyst specializing in Security Monitoring & Threat Response to join our dynamic team. This role offers the opportunity to innovate and implement cutting-edge security solutions, ensuring our business remains agile, secure, and ahead of emerging threats.  
  
As an IT&D Senior Cyber Analyst, you will be instrumental in detecting and responding to security incidents, conducting in-depth post-incident technical analysis, and managing security alerts across both IT and OT environments. You will collaborate closely with the Security Engineering Team to refine requirements, develop advanced threat detection mechanisms, create robust incident response playbooks, and implement automation strategies. Furthermore, you will actively participate in threat hunting exercises and contribute to the enhancement of our SIEM and EDR platforms.

**Your responsibilities**
-------------------------

Respond to, resolve, and escalate security incidents as required.  

* Contribute to the development and refinement of the IT security incident response process and supporting materials.
* Conduct threat hunting activities to identify threat actor groups and their tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs).
* Capture threat intelligence on actor TTPs and develop appropriate countermeasures.

* Assist with day-to-day cloud operations, including environment health checks, configuration reviews, access requests, backups, and resource inventory, starting in non-production environments under guidance.

* Support Jenkins-based CI/CD pipelines and build infrastructure; analyze pipeline results, build logs, and agent failures, and help keep controllers and agents healthy and current.

* Support security and compliance work, including IAM least-privilege reviews, key and secret hygiene, audit evidence collection, and control mapping for SOC 2 and FedRAMP.

title: AI Test Engineer
description:
Driven by the passion to improve quality of people’s lives, WSA continues to grow as market leader in the hearing aid industry. With our commitment to increase penetration in an underserved hearing care market, we want to accelerate our business transformation in order to reach more people, more effectively.

We are looking for an AI Test Engineer who combines strong software quality assurance and test automation experience with hands-on expertise in AI-assisted testing. The role involves using requirements such as user stories, acceptance criteria, and Figma designs to generate test scenarios and executable automated tests using AI tools.

The ideal candidate can effectively provide the right context to AI tools, validate AI-generated outputs, and continuously improve test development workflows to accelerate automation while ensuring high standards of quality, accuracy, traceability, and maintainability.

#### **What you will do**

* Use AI-assisted engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or similar solutions to translate user stories, acceptance criteria, and UI/UX specifications such as Figma designs into test scenarios and executable automated tests.
* Build and improve AI-assisted testing workflows where requirements and design artifacts can be provided as context and used to generate, update, and expand automated tests with minimal manual scripting.
* Apply prompt engineering and context engineering techniques to provide AI tools with requirements, application context, coding standards, existing automation frameworks, and relevant design information so that generated tests are accurate and maintainable.
* Review, validate, debug, and refine AI-generated test scenarios and automation code rather than accepting generated output without verification.
* Identify opportunities to automate the test-development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, test generation, test-data creation, regression maintenance, failure analysis, and coverage expansion.

#### **What you bring**

*Experience*

* 5–8 years of experience in software QA
* Hands-on experience using AI-assisted coding or engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or equivalent tools for software testing and test automation.
* Experience using requirements such as user stories, acceptance criteria, and UI/UX designs as context for AI-assisted generation of test scenarios and automated tests.
* Experience creating or configuring AI-assisted workflows that can transform requirements into executable automation, rather than using AI only for ad-hoc code completion or general-purpose prompting.
* Ability to provide application-specific context to AI tools, including existing automation code, framework conventions, requirements, design information, and test data, to improve generated test quality.
* Practical understanding of validating AI-generated tests for correctness, coverage, maintainability, traceability to requirements, and potential hallucinations or incorrect assumptions.

***Personal competencies***

* Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
* Attention to detail and a risk-based approach to quality assurance.
* Curiosity and a proactive mindset when exploring complex workflows and edge cases.
* Willingness to adopt AI-assisted tools to improve productivity and test coverage.
* Effective communication and collaboration across technical and clinical teams.
* Ownership of testing outcomes, defect resolution, and release quality.

#### **Who we are**

At WSA, we provide innovative hearing aids and hearing health services.

Together with our 12,000 colleagues in 130 countries, we invite you to help unlock human potential by bringing back hearing for millions of people around the world.

With us, you will become part of a truly global company where we care for one another, welcome diversity and celebrate our successes.

Sounds wonderful? We can't wait to hear from you.

*WSA is an equal-opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive employee experience for all. Regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition, ancestry, disability, military or veteran status we firmly believe that our work is at its best when everyone feels free to be their most authentic self.*

title: AI Enablement Engineer
description:
**Keyloop bridges the gap between dealers, manufacturers, technology suppliers and car buyers.**

We empower car dealers and manufacturers to fully embrace digital transformation. How? By creating innovative technology that makes selling cars better for our customers, and buying and owning cars better for theirs.

We use cutting-edge technology to link our clients’ systems, departments and sites. We provide an open technology platform that’s shaping the industry for the future. We use data to help clients become more efficient, increase profitability and give more customers an amazing experience. **Want to be part of it?**

**The Opportunity**

Keyloop is in the middle of an AI-enabled transformation, driven by the AI Empowered Programme — a board-mandated effort to lift AI maturity across our ~80 Product & Engineering teams. Two teams sit at the heart of it: Keystone, which builds the underlying AI capability and technical pathways, and Impost, which enables teams to adopt that capability hands-on.

We're looking for an highly motivated AI Enablement Engineer to join Impost and help our engineering teams put Keystone's AI capability to real, effective use. The primary mode of engagement is through a team's AI Champion — coaching, mentoring, or pairing with them to drive sustained, long-term change. You'll also work directly with teams for shorter periods to help resolve specific technical challenges, or gain the kind of deep, first-hand insight that's only visible from inside a team's day-to-day work and feeding it back into the programme.

  

This is a hands-on software engineering role, not an "engineer who used to code." You'll sit on the frontline of AI-driven development lifecycle innovation at Keyloop — as part of the Impost team, you'll be the first adopter team for Keystone's experimental new solutions, taking ownership of real internal systems as genuine test grounds. You'll contribute directly to Keystone's solutions — sometimes through early feedback on what's rough or missing, sometimes through hands-on contribution and pull requests.  
  
Keyloop itself is a dual-speed technology organization: a large, successful DMS heritage business running on established platforms built up over decades, alongside Fusion — a modern, cloud-native Automotive Retail Platform built on AWS, event-driven domain services. You won't need to master every technology across that estate yourself — each team owns its own stack, and that expertise stays with them. Your focus is AI: helping teams leverage Claude Code, skills, agents, and Keystone's recommended solutions effectively, whatever stack they happen to be working in.

### **What You'll Bring**

Must-have:

* Fluency in AI assisted and agentic software development

* Strong, hands-on engineering background with genuine credibility pairing and mentoring other engineers on real technical problems.

* Comfort mastering new, evolving AI capability early — often ahead of formal documentation or a fixed playbook.

* A genuine interest in, and demonstrated ability to have a strong positive impact on the growth of others — through pairing, mentoring, coaching, or developer advocacy. This role is built around lifting other people up, not working heads-down in isolation; if that's not energizing to you, this isn't the right fit.

* Ability to read a team's context and choose the right mode of engagement (direct vs. through a Champion) rather than applying one approach everywhere.

* Experience working effectively across a distributed, multi-location engineering organisation.

* Based in, or willing to work from, Oulu, Finland or Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam.

### **What You'll Do**

* Direct & Champion-Mediated Enablement: Provide hands-on technical support, training, and mentoring on Keystone's AI capability — working directly with a team or through its AI Champion, depending on context and champion maturity.

* Champion Development: Build the technical capability of AI Champions so they can scale enablement within their own teams, multiplying Impost's reach beyond what a small central team could do alone.

* Early Adoption ("Dogfooding"): Take ownership of real internal systems — starting with the OEM TTV Dashboard — as the test ground for Keystone's experimental new solutions before they reach any other team. Build with them, break them, and feed what you learn directly back into Keystone's own development, through early feedback or, where appropriate, hands-on contribution and pull requests.

* Field Feedback & Cross-Pollination: Surface what works and what doesn't from real engagements; escalate unresolved technical friction to Keystone; spot effective practices in one team and help spread them to others.

* Triage: Recognise when a team's blocker isn't a technical/AI problem, and surface it to the Enablement Workstream for routing — rather than trying to solve it yourself.

* Community & Advocacy: Stay active in relevant AI communities of practice and forums as a natural part of the job; contribute technical content, demos, or talks as capacity allows.

* AI Landscape & Continuous Learning  
  Proactively track developments in AI tooling and practices internally and externally. Bring relevant insights into the organisation and translate them into actionable enablement opportunities before they are asked for.

### **Nice-to-have:**

* A genuine interest in agile ways of working, and how they intersect with AI-driven change. You'll work closely with Agile Coaches on adoption that disrupts both what a team builds with and how a team works — the more fluently you can partner with them across both dimensions, the more effective that adoption becomes.

* Prior experience in a platform, developer-experience, or enablement-focused engineering role.

### **Nice to Have**

* A genuine interest in agile ways of working, and how they intersect with AI-driven change. You'll work closely with Agile Coaches on adoption that disrupts both what a team builds with and how a team works — the more fluently you can partner with them across both dimensions, the more effective that adoption becomes.

* Prior experience in a platform, developer-experience, or enablement-focused engineering role.

**Why join us?**

We’re on a journey to become market leaders in our space – and with that comes some incredible opportunities. Collaborate and learn from industry experts from all over the globe. Work with game-changing products and services. Get the training and support you need to try new things, adapt to quick changes and explore different paths. Join Keyloop and progress your career, your way.

**An inclusive environment to thrive**

We’re committed to fostering an inclusive work environment. One that respects all dimensions of diversity. We promote an inclusive culture within our business, and we celebrate different employees and lifestyles – not just on key days, but every day.

**Be rewarded for your efforts**

We believe people should be paid based on their performance so our pay and benefits reflect this and are designed to attract the very best talent. We encourage everyone in our organisation to explore opportunities which enable them to grow their career through investment in their development but equally by working in a culture which fosters support and unbridled collaboration.

Keyloop doesn’t require academic qualifications for this position. We select based on experience and potential, not credentials.

**We are also an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce. We value diversity and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply***.*

*"****At Keyloop, AI is a daily ally: We encourage and train every employee to use our AI tools to boost their creativity and productivity.****"*

title: Principal AI/ML Architect
description:
**About Egen**:

  

Egen is a fast-growing, entrepreneurial technology company with a data-first mindset. We bring together exceptional engineering talent and advanced technology platforms, including Google Cloud and Salesforce, to help clients drive action and impact through data and insights.

We are committed to being a place where talented people choose to do their best work - applying deep engineering and technology expertise to envision how data, AI, and platforms can change the world for the better. We are dedicated to learning, thrive on solving difficult problems, and continually innovate to achieve fast, effective results. If that describes you, we want you on our team.

### **About the opportunity:**

As a Principal AI/ML Architect, you will set the technical direction for Egen's most complex generative AI, agentic AI, and applied machine learning engagements while remaining personally hands-on in the work that matters most. We treat AI as a software engineering discipline. You will raise that bar by architecting systems that succeed in production and helping the engineers around you do the same.

  

You will own the hardest architectural problems in our portfolio: agentic platforms operating at scale, applied-ML solutions, advanced retrieval systems, and AI in regulated or high-stakes environments where being wrong is expensive. Document intelligence and RAG pipelines are part of your toolkit, not the ceiling. You will take systems from an ambiguous business problem to a robust, scalable service, solving for latency, reliability, cost, security, and governance.

  

You will also be the senior technical face of our engagements. You will partner directly with client leadership to translate business strategy into AI architecture, shape solutions during pre-sales, guide engineering teams, and earn the trust that turns a project into a long-term program.

### **What you will do:**

* **Set enterprise AI architecture and technical direction:** Own the end-to-end architecture for complex GenAI, agentic AI, and ML platforms. Define reference architectures, reusable patterns, engineering guardrails, and technology choices across engagements.
* **Build at the frontier - hands-on:** Stay close to the code on the highest-leverage technical work, including foundation-model and embedding fine-tuning, advanced RAG, semantic search, evaluation harnesses, and novel agentic workflows using Python and Google Cloud Vertex AI.
* **Engineer AI for production:** Design for latency, reliability, security, cost, scalability, and maintainability from day one. Apply disciplined MLOps and LLMOps practices so systems are versioned, evaluated, monitored, deployed, and continuously improved.
* **Architect agentic systems at scale:** Design and operate multi-step reasoning and multi-agent workflows using ADK, LangChain, MCP, and custom agent frameworks, with robust orchestration, state management, tool use, memory, human oversight, failure isolation, and verification controls.

* **Establish evaluation, observability, and responsible AI standards:** Define measurable quality criteria and production telemetry for accuracy, groundedness, safety, drift, latency, and cost. Embed privacy, security, governance, and responsible AI throughout the lifecycle.
* **Shape data and retrieval architectures:** Design production-scale retrieval and knowledge systems spanning data ingestion, chunking, metadata, embeddings, vector and hybrid search, re-ranking, provenance, permissions, and continuous content refresh.
* **Advise clients and shape opportunities:** Partner with client executives and engineering leaders to translate business strategy into AI roadmaps and solution architectures. Lead discovery, technical workshops, estimates, trade-off discussions, and pre-sales solutioning.
* **Multiply engineering capability:** Raise the technical bar through architecture reviews, design documents, code reviews, mentoring, reusable accelerators, and clear standards that help senior and mid-level engineers deliver with greater confidence.
* **Own outcomes across the full lifecycle:** Guide initiatives from problem framing and experimentation through production rollout, operational readiness, adoption, and measurable business value. Surface risks early and drive decisions to resolution.

### **Your technical toolkit:**

**Languages and software engineering**

Expert-level Python; strong shell scripting; API and service design; clean, tested, maintainable code; distributed-system fundamentals; and full SDLC ownership.

  

**Models and AI ecosystem**

Deep, current expertise with Google Gemini, GPT-class models, LLaMA and other open models; advanced prompt engineering; structured outputs; model selection; fine-tuning; and rigorous evaluation.

  

**Agentic AI engineering**

Hands-on production experience with Google Agent Development Kit (ADK), LangChain, custom agent frameworks, tool use, Model Context Protocol (MCP), workflow orchestration, planning, memory, state, guardrails, human-in-the-loop controls, and multi-agent design.

  

**Retrieval and search**

Advanced RAG, hybrid and semantic search, embeddings, re-ranking, and vector platforms such as Vertex AI Vector Search, pgvector, Pinecone, or equivalent technologies.

  

**Cloud infrastructure and AI systems**

End-to-end experience architecting highly available, scalable AI and software environments across Google Cloud / Vertex AI, AWS, and Azure, including model serving, data integration, IAM, networking, security, observability, and cost management.

  

**Frameworks**

Strong command of LangChain, LlamaIndex, or equivalent orchestration layers - together with the judgment to use simpler, more maintainable patterns when appropriate.

  

**MLOps and LLMOps**

CI/CD, model and prompt versioning, experiment tracking, automated evaluation, observability, model monitoring, drift detection, rollback, and production incident response.

  

**Data and ML foundations**

Strong SQL and data engineering; classical machine learning; neural networks; training, tuning, and inference; and the ability to connect data quality to model and product outcomes.

### **Basic qualifications:**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field; equivalent practical experience will also be considered.

* 15+ years of progressive experience across software engineering, machine learning, data, or AI, including substantial ownership of production systems at scale.
* Demonstrated principal-level technical leadership, including architecture ownership, cross-team technical direction, and decision-making across complex engagements or product portfolios.
* A proven record of deploying generative AI, agentic AI, and/or applied-ML products into production - beyond proofs of concept.
* Deep hands-on expertise with Python, modern LLM and ML architectures, agent frameworks, Google Cloud / Vertex AI, production APIs, and scalable software systems.
* Experience establishing evaluation, observability, security, privacy, governance, and responsible AI controls for enterprise AI solutions.
* Strong data engineering and SQL knowledge, with the ability to design reliable data and retrieval foundations for AI products.
* Senior client-facing experience, with the communication skills to explain technical choices, risks, and business value to executive stakeholders and engineering teams.

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience training, tuning, or adapting neural networks, embedding models, or foundation models.
* Architecture experience in regulated or high-stakes domains such as healthcare, financial services, or the public sector.
* Google Cloud Professional Machine Learning Engineer, Professional Cloud Architect, or comparable certification.
* Experience building reusable AI accelerators, reference implementations, or platform capabilities across multiple clients or product teams.
* Pre-sales experience including discovery workshops, solution shaping, estimation, proposal development, and technical presentations.
* Familiarity or good to have understanding with Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, event-driven architectures, and modern data platforms.

description:

Our team uses deep knowledge of the attacker landscape and rich telemetry from our sensors to perform root-cause analysis and generate custom alerts, ensuring that Microsoft 365 Defender customers are well equipped to quickly respond to human adversaries identified in their unique environments. Ensuring that no human adversary can operate silently begins with experts harnessing the powerful optics provided by Microsoft 365 Defender, across the attacker kill-chain, coupled with world-class detections. We are looking for someone who is passionate about this work to help us harness the power of Microsoft’s trillions of security signals to quickly identify and report the latest human adversary behaviors, drive critical context-rich alerts, build new tools and automations in support of hunting objectives, and drive innovations for detecting advanced attacker tradecraft.
